title: TextArea
description: A multi-line text input with label, validation states, character count, auto-resize, clearable, and icon support.

label.description: React.ReactNode — Label displayed above the textarea.

description.description: React.ReactNode — Description text below the label.

error.description: Whether the textarea is in an error state.

errorMessage.description: React.ReactNode — Error message displayed below the textarea.

success.description: Green success state for validated fields.

successMessage.description: React.ReactNode — Success message displayed below the textarea.

size.description: Visual size variant. Emits data-size on the root container for CSS targeting.

startIcon.description: React.ReactNode — Icon rendered before the textarea.

endIcon.description: React.ReactNode — Icon rendered after the textarea.

onStartIconClick.description: () => void — Makes startIcon a clickable button.

onEndIconClick.description: () => void — Makes endIcon a clickable button.

startIconLabel.description: Accessible label for startIcon when clickable. Required with onStartIconClick.

endIconLabel.description: Accessible label for endIcon when clickable. Required with onEndIconClick.

onValueChange.description: (value: string) => void — Fires with the current string value when the value changes.

clearable.description: Show a built-in clear button when the textarea has a value.

onClear.description: () => void — Callback when the clear button is clicked.

showCount.description: Show character count (requires maxLength to be set).

autoResize.description: Automatically resize height to fit content.

loading.description: Whether the textarea is in a loading state.

loaderSize.description: Size of the default CircularLoader in pixels.

fullWidth.description: Whether the textarea expands to fill its parent container.

className.description: CSS class for the root container element.

classes.description: Slot-based class overrides for internal elements.

unstyled.description: When true, all default classes are removed; only classes overrides apply.
